text: Craters on the surface of distant planets are thought to have been formed by impacts from asteroids or comets. These craters can be so large that they are visible from Earth, and the surfaces of the planets, including Mars, appear in the form of craters. For example, the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter has captured images of the largest known crater on Mars, which is the 3, 200-kilometer-wide Hellas Planum, a large impact crater.
